 Gold rate: Gold prices for 22k jewellery rose today in various showrooms across cities like Delhi and Mumbai. In contrast, the IBJA indicated a decline in gold and silver rates compared to yesterday's evening rates. Listen to this article in summarized format
 Listen ET Online ​ Gold rate today: 24k vs 22k vs 20k vs 18k prices​ Gold prices moved higher today (Tuesday, October 27, 2026) across major jewellery brands, including Tanishq, Malabar Gold & Diamonds, Kalyan Jewellers and Joyalukkas. However, the India Bullion and Jewellers Association’s (IBJA) latest gold and silver jewellery indicative rates showed a decline compared to the prices on Monday evening. The contrasting price movements on jewellery brands and the IBJA are worth noting for consumers planning to purchase gold or silver jewellery during the festive season.
 Gold-silver outlook
Prithviraj Kothari, Managing Director at RiddiSiddhi Bullions Ltd., President of IBJA says, "Gold fell below $4,000 last week for the first time since mid-July, posting a 4% weekly loss, its worst in about four months, as rising energy prices stoked inflation fears and US rate hike bets. A firmer dollar added pressure on Tuesday ahead of the Fed meeting. Policymakers have signalled no hike this week, but traders still see an 82% chance of a December increase. Geopolitical risks linger in the Gulf, even as diplomatic efforts with Iran continue. Technically, gold may slide towards $3,950 (~₹1,40,000) and silver towards $50, though both are building a base, with a 10–15% rebound possible."

Here is a look at today’s 22k gold jewellery rates from Tanishq, Malabar Gold & Diamonds, Kalyan Jewellers and Joyalukkas across Delhi, Mumbai, Chennai and Kolkata. 
Also have a look at the IBJA’s latest 24k, 22k, 20k, 18k and 14k indicative gold jewellery rates and the 999-purity silver jewellery price.

As of October 27, 2026, Tanishq's price of 22k gold jewellery is Rs 13,175 per gram across Delhi showrooms. On October 26, 2026, the 22k gold price at Tanishq in Delhi was Rs 13,125 per gram.
